author: Inside Edition
description: Gamers the world over are in the grips of "Grand Theft Auto" mania. After a 13-year wait, the highly anticipated sixth installment of the popular video game franchise had an epic launch. But if you thought GTA was just a “shoot 'em up,” type of game, think again. You may be shocked to hear that at its heart, it's a love story. Some observers even liken the game's central character to Bonnie and Clyde. Inside Edition's Jim Moret has the details.
title: How 'Grand Theft Auto' Is Actually A Love Story

author: Inside Edition
description: Fiona the hippo has died after a medical crisis, the Cincinnati Zoo announced. Fiona had been under round-the-clock care after a child’s wool-knit hat fell into the hippo’s habitat at the zoo. The 2,500-pound animal ate it and lost her appetite soon after. Since surgery was not an option for full-grown hippos, the zoo’s medical staff had given Fiona laxatives and hoped nature would do the rest. “We are in shock at the moment,” the Cincinnati Zoo said.
title: Beloved Fiona The Hippo Dies At Cincinnati Zoo

author: Inside Edition
description: The viral "Sister" sketch got big laughs on "Saturday Night Live" this past weekend. The pre-taped segment starred guest host John Mulaney and cast member Jane Wickline spoofing a pharmaceutical commercial. It poked fun at gender roles, and how caring for aging parents overwhelmingly falls on daughters instead of sons. As Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano reports, the bit has set off an avalanche of reactions.
title: Why 'SNL's' 'Sister' Sketch Struck A Nerve

author: Inside Edition
description: It was 32 years ago when Susan Smith drove her car into a lake with her two children, killing them. Smith was convicted of two counts of murder in 1995, and she has been in prison ever since. Today she was up for parole, and her former husband, David Smith, appeared at the hearing. David was in tears, pleading with a judge to not let his ex-wife out of prison. Inside Edition's Steven Fabian tells us what happened.
title: Susan Smith Denied Parole In Murder Of Her 2 Sons

author: Inside Edition
description: Body camera footage shows the moment police arrived at a blazing house fire where a father and his 4-year-old son were trapped inside. Mom was frantic as a police officer entered the home through the garage. The officer stepped into the smoke without an oxygen tank and any protective gear. At one point, he retreated repeatedly, telling the family to stay back. The officer was able to reach the father and son and lead them to safety.
title: Bodycam Footage Shows Michigan House Fire Rescue

author: Inside Edition
description: The recent nationwide plane grounding and computer outages couldn't have come at a worse time – just as the holiday travel rush gets underway. Many people who are still jittery about cancellations and delays at airports are choosing to hit the road this Thanksgiving, instead of flying. The uncertainty adds an extra layer of stress to the already stressful Thanksgiving rush. Inside Edition's Alison Hall reports.
title: Airport Jitters Causing Many To Drive Instead Of Fly For Thanksgiving

author: Inside Edition
description: Anyone wanting to live out their fantasies of being Batman can get a lot of props  if they have a high enough bid. Propstore Auction is currently accepting bids for items from many of the Batman movies throughout the years. They include costumes worn by Michael Keaton, Val Kilmer and Christian Bale, but the show-stopping item has to be The Batpod. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: The Batpod From 'The Dark Knight' Up For Auction

author: Inside Edition
description: A lost toddler was located just in time. The Pinal County Sheriff’s Office in Arizona says the child wandered away from home around just as the sun was setting. They say temperatures dropped quickly and they had to find her before it got too cold. Deputies and volunteers scoured the rural area and after about seven hours, a volunteer spotted the 2-year-old hiding inside a bush, wearing only a diaper. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Searcher Finds Missing Toddler Hiding In Bush 2 Miles From Home

author: Inside Edition
description: AI company Anthropic made its long-awaited debut on the stock market Thursday, raising a record-breaking $81 billion in its IPO launch, which beat SpaceX’s initial IPO of $75 million. The buying frenzy pushed Anthropic’s market value past $2 trillion, making it the biggest IPO of all time. To mark the event, company officials rang Thursday’s opening bell at the Nasdaq in New York City’s Times Square.
title: Anthropic Goes Public, Becoming Largest IPO in History At Over $2 Trillion

author: Inside Edition
description: A 30-foot-tall Christmas tree made of LEGO and DUPLO bricks has been unveiled at Legoland Windsor Resort in the Britain. It took workers nearly 3,000 hours and 364,481 blocks to construct the holiday decoration, and it’s safe to say no one will be stepping on these Lego pieces. The tree marks the start of Legoland Windsor’s Christmas festivities, which run until Jan. 3.
title: 30-Foot-Tall Christmas Tree Is Made Entirely From Legos

author: Inside Edition
description: A German man named Sebastian, who uses the moniker der Schaelm, has a mighty wind of more than 109,000 Instagram followers. His talent? Making musical flatulence by pushing air through his hands. Sebastian says he has been doing this since he was 11 and started the sound effects to make his friends laugh. Now an adult, he gave the world something to chuckle about during the COVID pandemic by posting videos showcasing his abilities. He now has an international following.
title: Meet the World’s Most Famous Hand Fartist

author: Inside Edition
description: Talk about a close call! The Concord Fire Department in North Carolina stepped in to help an owl that flew into the grille of a car and became stuck. The owl was surprisingly calm despite its uncomfortable ordeal. After a few minutes, the team was able to free the visibly stunned bird. She was taken to the Carolina Wildlife Rehabilitation Center, where staff said she showed signs of head trauma. Inside Edition Digital has more
title: Owl Rescued After Flying Into Grille Of Car
